title: System 2: n8n workflow-generation system

body:
## System 2: n8n workflow-generation system

Built a system on top of n8n in which Claude generated complete, importable workflow JSON already aligned with Lohith's established credential conventions.

Workflow and output:

- Described the intended automation at the workflow level.
- Generated the complete n8n definition rather than manually assembling every step in the interface.
- Imported the definition into the existing credential setup.
- Reused the approach across two production systems.
- Built 23+ workflows.
- Reduced idea-to-running-workflow time to under 10 minutes.

Maintainability evidence:

- Repeated workflow structure lives in a reusable generation pattern.
- Credential conventions and workflow structure remain consistent across generated definitions.
- A system-level change can be made in the generation approach instead of repeated manually in many workflows.

Do not move the `23+ workflows` or `under 10 minutes` figures to another employer.
